title: DeGenTWeb: A First Look at MGT-dominant Websites
abstract: arXiv:2605.00087v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many news reports have claimed that machine-generated text (MGT) from large language models (LLMs) is taking over the web. However, these claims are typically not based on a representative sample of the web, and the methodology underlying them is often opaque. Consequently, we lack an understanding of the true prevalence and characteristics of MGT on the web.   We describe DeGenTWeb, which systematically identifies MGT-dominant websites: sites whose informational prose content is mostly MGT, with little human input. We show how to adapt detectors of MGT for use on web pages, and how to aggregate detection results from multiple pages on a site for accurate site-level categorization. DeGenTWeb mislabels only 0.12% of human-authored sites as MGT-dominant. translated_title: DeGenTWeb：首次审视以机器生成文本为主的网站
translated_abstract: 许多新闻报道声称，来自大语言模型（LLM）的机器生成文本（MGT）正在接管网络。然而，这些说法通常并非基于具有代表性的网络样本，且其背后的方法往往不透明。因此，我们目前缺乏对网络上机器生成文本真实普及程度和特征的了解。我们提出了 DeGenTWeb，一个系统性识别“机器生成文本主导型网站”的方法，即那些信息性散文内容大部分由机器生成、几乎不包含人类输入的网站。我们展示了如何将机器生成文本检测器适配到网页上使用，以及如何汇总来自同一网站多个页面的检测结果，以实现准确的网站级分类。DeGenTWeb 仅将 0.12% 的人类撰写网站误标为机器生成文本主导型网站。我们发现，Common Crawl 在2026年1月至7月期间存档的网站中有 20.9%，以及2025年 Bing 搜索结果所链接的网站中有 13.6% 属于机器生成文本主导型网站。
tldr: 提出了 DeGenTWeb 框架，通过将机器生成文本检测器适配到网页并聚合网站级检测结果，首次系统识别出以机器生成内容为主的网站，发现 Common Crawl 存档网站中 20.9% 和 Bing 搜索结果链接网站中 13.6% 属于机器生成文本主导型。
en_tdlr: DeGenTWeb is the first systematic framework for identifying MGT-dominant websites by adapting MGT detectors to web pages and aggregating site-level results, revealing that 20.9% of Common Crawl sites (Jan–Jul 2026) and 13.6% of Bing-linked sites (2025) are predominantly machine-generated.
